Who is Alan M. Kobayashi?

Alan M. Kobayashi belongs to Star Trek. Kobayashi was a Starfleet officer during the Dominion War.

In 2374 and 2375, files from the starships, and, as well as the Allied Romulan vessel, all reported Lieutenant Kobayashi missing in action. Files from the and reported him killed.
